Airborne time (maintenance hours) Most accurate source wins — track file › tracker › take-off/landing clock › brakes − 10 min. Once a sheet is settled nothing automatic changes it.
Recalculate airborne time over the history

Dry run reports what would change and why (nothing is written). Read the biggest moves: a flight whose track and tracker disagree by hours is a mis-linked recording, not a correction. Apply writes the best figure on every non-manual sheet, stamps its source, locks every row older than 2 days, and rebuilds the logbooks of every aircraft touched. Chunked — large histories take several requests. One-shot: after the first applied run only provisional sheets are ever read again — a settled figure is corrected by hand on its own sheet (flight edit or re-evaluate), never by this tool.

Split flights to review Split pairs whose recorded track shows no landing between the legs — all clubs

Each pair was booked in as two flights on a tracker boundary the track disproves (a GPS speed glitch or a fast taxi). Undo the split folds leg 2 back into leg 1 and recalculates unpaid invoices; Keep it hides the pair. Club managers see the same list for their own club under Manage Club → Flights.
